About these names

Dwarven names are short, blunt and consonant-heavy — built to be shouted across a forge. Doubled consonants and hard stops (b, d, g, k, th) dominate, and vowels stay tight. Most run two syllables, and the Norse Dvergatal is the ancestor of nearly every dwarf name in modern fantasy.
